# Navayan (नवयान)

> Navayan is a Marathi-first learning platform. Our aim is to help children learn beyond textbooks, discover new things and learn about the opportunities ahead of them.

नवयान हे मराठी-प्रथम शिक्षण व्यासपीठ आहे. मुलांना पुस्तकांच्या पलीकडे जाऊन शिकता यावं, नवनवीन गोष्टींची ओळख व्हावी आणि भविष्यातील संधींची माहिती मिळावी, हा आमचा प्रयत्न.

## Key facts
- Course: Navayan Foundation Course (नवयान पायाभूत अभ्यासक्रम)
- Audience: children aged 12–16 and their parents; one adult account per mobile number
- Structure: 6 levels × 20 units × 3 chapters = 120 units, 360 narrated interactive lessons
- Levels: The World Around Us, Our Bodies, Our World, Science, Maths & Society, Our Earth, Our People, Think, Create & Solve, Learn, Apply & Grow
- Subjects: Science, Maths, English, Society, Life skills
- Language: Marathi (English toggle in the app); Devanagari numerals
- How to buy: download the Android app (Google Play, coming soon), register with a mobile number, subscribe in the app; the subscription includes the digital book, the 360 lessons and the printed book delivered to the home address entered in the app
- Already have the book: the 12-character activation code under the scratch panel unlocks the course (single use)
- Platforms: Android app and the web
- Founder: Dr. Angad J.K.

## How it works
1. Get the app: Scan the QR code here or download the Navayan app from Google Play.
2. Register: Enter the parent's mobile number and sign in with the OTP. One account per number.
3. Subscribe: Subscribe to the course inside the app — the digital book and 360 lessons open right away.
4. Add your address: Enter where the printed book should go. It arrives straight at your door.
5. Start learning: Open the book, start the same unit's lesson in the app — one unit a day.
